newsitem.title: JAPAN: Malaysia '97 LPG freight set at $32.75-$34 - traders.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia '97 LPG freight set at $32.75-$34 - traders.

text.p: Malaysia and Japanese importers of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) have agreed to set freight rates for 1997 term cargoes at $32.75 to $34.00 per tonne, traders said on Thursday.

The freight rate was set at around $32.75 per tonne for importers who intend to buy 120,000 tonnes, or four cargoes, a year, they said. It was fixed at around $33.50 for importers buying two cargoes and about $34.00 for those who plan to purchase just one cargo, they said.
For the term year ended in October, the freight rate for Malaysian term cargoes was set at $38.00 for the first cargo, $37.00 for the second and $36.00 for the third, they said.

Despite the year-on-year decline in freight rates, some traders said the new level should have been set lower because the freight rate for 1996 Kuwaiti term cargoes was set at $30.00 per tonne for Japan.

Traders said that under the new contract with Malaysia, five Japanese importers are expected to buy a total 360,000 tonnes of term cargoes. The importers would pay the freight plus Saudi Arabia's contract prices for the Malaysian term cargoes to be delivered by the supplier, they added.
